Form Details
Choose Your Totem — Locked for life

Totems start with 4 Defense, 1d4×Level HP. Lasts until destroyed or picked up. Can be slotted into a belt slot and cast as a bonus action once created.
At Shaman level 4, Rank 2 totems gain +3 Defense (4 + 3 = 7) and their hit die is improved to 1d6 (1d6×Level HP).

Active Totems
Totem Fusion (Level 4+)

Totem Fusion — Twice per long rest, when you drop your second totem, as part of the same action, you may fuse your totems to gain increased effects for three rounds. The totem fusion will become a singular totem and will occupy one of the spaces of your existing totems (Shaman's choice), and it will have the combined health totals of both totems. Alternatively you may cast this as a bonus action. Refer to the Hybrid Totems table below to see effects.

CHARGES (resets on long rest): 2 / 2 max
Hybrid Totems (Level 4+) — Require Empowered Totem
HYBRID TOTEM MANA EFFECT
Martial Arts Stances

At Pugilist level 2 you choose 2 Martial Arts Stances. Stances can be activated and swapped by spending all of your movement speed, or by spending 1 stamina and a bonus action. Each stance has a passive ability, a stamina-usage active ability, and a weakness that comes along with it.

Select your two stances below. You can change your selections at any time. The stance you currently have active in combat can be flagged with the Active toggle for quick reference.

Your Stances
Choose Your Stances — Pick 2
Lay on Hands — Healing Pool

As an action, restore health equal to Paladin level × 5 to any friendly target — you must place your hands on the target to heal them. You draw from a shared pool of healing points; spend any amount up to what remains. Restores after a long rest.

Elemental Bow — Elemental Hunter

Elemental Hunters are known for hunting the most dangerous elementals that cross from the elemental plane to this one. Their experience hunting elementals has given them the ability to use the essence of fallen elementals as a devastating hunting mechanism. These hunters have forgone the ability to tame a pet, as their hunts take them to planes where an animal could not, or would not survive.

Summon an elemental bow of your choice as a bonus action which lasts the duration of combat. Choose between Lightning, Fire, Ice, and Earth — this may not be changed between arrow shots. This bow resembles the element which was chosen and grants powerful abilities. It grants two special elemental arrows which can be fired in one combat, or saved until a long rest is taken (at which point you would lose your saved arrows). Charges recharge after a full rest.

Bow Charges & Arrows
BOW CHARGES (full rest): 1 / 1 max

ELEMENTAL ARROWS:

Each summoned bow grants 2 elemental arrows for the combat. Click a pip to mark an arrow fired or unfire it.

Summon Bow — Choose Element

Select the element you are summoning. This cannot be changed between arrow shots while the bow is active. Summoning a bow resets your elemental arrows to 2.

Pantheon of Worship

At level 1, pick 1 God to devote yourself to as the start of your pantheon of worship. These Gods allow different favors when you have saved enough favor to call upon. In addition to favor, your pantheon determines your favor by either the Light, Balance or the Darkness.

If your first God chosen is a God of Light, you are favored by the Light, granting +1 to all healing/utility spells. If favored by a God of Darkness, you receive +1 to all shadow spells and effects. If favored by Balance, +1 Armor and +1 Magic Armor.

Favor

Earn favor by casting spells as miracles in combat. At 10 favor you are favored and may spend favor with your God. Max favor is 10, increasing by 10 at levels 7 and 13. Favor drops by 1 after every long or full rest, and 1d6 when you level up (down to the nearest breakpoint of 10/20/30).

SAVED FAVOR: 0 / 10 max

⛺ Take a Rest

Short Rest — Lasts ~30 minutes. Drink potions, ready items, cast preparatory spells. Stamina users recover 1 Stamina. Mana users recover 1 Mana. No hit die are recovered. A healer's kit is required to use hit die during a short rest.

Long Rest — 6 hours. First 4 hours: +1 HP, +1 Mana, +1 Stamina automatically. After 4 hours: restore up to 1 hit die. Benefits depend on camp quality.
